clause: Cross-backend promotion-equivalence golden coverage for every effect row [STU-FX-037]

scope.summary: Assert every 14.9 catalog effect row is covered by the 14.24 golden-image validation set: for a given effect kind+params+seed+StudioColorProfile output is byte-stable on a fixed backend and within declared promotion-equivalence tolerance across backends (CPU fallback, Vulkan, Metal, DX12, WebGPU); an effect whose backends disagree beyond tolerance FAILS validation and cannot be promoted. Coverage check enumerates all implemented effect_kind and fails if any lacks a golden entry.
acceptance_criteria: every effect row covered by 14.24 golden set; byte-stable per backend + tolerance across backends; out-of-tolerance blocks promotion
expected_tests: multi-backend: sample effects byte-stable per backend + within tolerance across CPU/Vulkan/Metal/DX12/WebGPU
test: coverage check fails if any implemented effect_kind lacks a 14.24 golden entry
negative: out-of-tolerance effect blocked from promotion

gui_obligation.not_applicable_reason: Headless/backend MT: no operator-visible surface changed.

user_manual_obligation.not_applicable_reason: Non-product-behavior or internal-scaffold MT; UserManual updated by the consuming feature MT.

risk_if_missed: Backends silently diverge; effects promoted with non-equivalent output.

risks: Scaffold-only claim without runtime proof (Spec-Realism Gate).
Domain MT forking a canonical primitive instead of referencing 14.23.
PostgreSQL/SQLite creep or a write that bypasses the typed SurrealDB boundary on a studio_* authority path.
minimum_controls: At least one proof command exercises executable runtime or a Handshake-managed resource boundary.
Reference canonical primitives (14.23); no shadow primitives.
no_legacy_database_tripwire plus typed-SurrealDB-boundary proof on every authority write.
